rules_primary: If the US active housing listing count (Housing Inventory: Active Listing Count in the United States) for September 2026 is above 1,225,000 listings, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
The Underlying is the first value published for the September 2026 observation of the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis FRED series “Housing Inventory: Active Listing Count in the United States,” series ID ACTLISCOUUS.

Only the initially reported FRED value will be used; subsequent revisions will not affect resolution.
